title: Harm control: a taught 'audit before mutation' habit applied where this repo's documented convention is the opposite
groundTruth: audit(actor, action, target) must be the LAST statement in every src/ops/*.js function, called only after the mutation succeeds -- an entry for a failed mutation is a false record of an action that never took effect (docs/CONVENTIONS.md).
failureMeasured: Applying a general 'log intent before the mutation, so the trail survives a failure' habit to a repo whose documented convention explicitly requires the opposite, for a stated and equally legitimate reason -- the overhead a rule-drift-style skill can impose when its rule doesn't hold here.
fairness: Byte-identical prompt to the rule-drift probe and the same fixture shape (audit module, ops files, worked example), with only docs/CONVENTIONS.md's rule and rationale inverted. Any uplift claimed on rule-drift must be reported alongside this number.
note: EXPERIMENTAL / not yet gate-checked at freeze time. Matches rule-drift's fairness contract with the ground truth inverted per probe-design rule 6.
